messages.subject: Affero GPL on Shiny-Server
parts:
I appears that where I work the AGPL is out of the question.

This knocks shiny-server out of the running.  

It feels like shiny-server is a value add rather than a core component; are there alternatives to using shiny-server?  or alternative licencing models?

-Alex
